nearest_airport.name: Martín Miguel de Güemes International Airport

places.name: Salta Cathedral
places.ai_summary: Salta's main cathedral, located on Plaza 9 de Julio. Known for its beautiful pink Baroque facade and ornate interior. Houses the ashes of General Güemes and the miraculous statues of Lord and Virgin of the Miracle.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary; check locally, especially around mass times

places.place_tip: Visit during daylight to appreciate the interior. Dress respectfully. Located on the main square, easy to combine with other central sights.
places.address: España 558, A4400 Salta, Argentina

places.name: Plaza 9 de Julio
places.ai_summary: Salta's main square, the heart of the historic center. Surrounded by colonial-era buildings including the Cathedral, Cabildo (historical museum), MAAM museum, and numerous cafes under arcades ('recovas'). Features gardens and a central monument.

opening_hours.notes: Public square

places.place_tip: Great spot for people-watching from a cafe under the arcades. Visit the Cabildo museum. Starting point for exploring the historic center.
places.address: Plaza 9 de Julio, A4400 Salta, Argentina

attribution.title: CABA - Avenida 9 de Julio
attribution.author: Fernando
attribution.description: Avenida 9 de Julio in Buenos Aires, Argentina

places.name: Cerro San Bernardo Cable Car
places.ai_summary: Cable car ('teleférico') ascending Cerro San Bernardo, a hill overlooking Salta city. Offers panoramic views of the city, Lerma Valley, and surrounding mountains from the top. Features viewpoints, cafes, and waterfalls.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary seasonally, check website or locally; last ascent earlier

places.suggested_duration: 1.5-2.5 hours (including ride and time at top)
places.best_time_to_visit: Clear days for best views, late afternoon/sunset
places.place_tip: Base station is near Parque San Martín. Can also drive or walk up (long walk). Allow time to enjoy the views from the summit.
places.address: Base Station: Av. San Martín cnr. H. Yrigoyen, Salta / Summit: Cerro San Bernardo, Salta

places.name: MAAM Museum (High Mountain Archaeology)
places.ai_summary: Museo de Arqueología de Alta Montaña (MAAM) houses the incredibly well-preserved mummified remains of three Inca children ('Children of Llullaillaco'), discovered near the summit of Llullaillaco volcano, along with associated artifacts. Offers a unique glimpse into Inca rituals.

opening_hours.notes: Check website for current hours and which mummy is currently displayed (rotated for conservation)

places.place_tip: Located on Plaza 9 de Julio. Photography is usually restricted inside. The exhibit is sensitive due to the human remains but provides significant archaeological insight.
places.advanced_booking: Not usually required, but can buy online
places.address: Mitre 77, A4400 Salta, Argentina
places.name_native: Museo de Arqueología de Alta Montaña (MAAM)

places.name: San Francisco Church
places.ai_summary: Impressive church in Salta city center, noted for its striking terracotta and yellow facade and tall bell tower (one of the highest in South America). Features Baroque architecture and houses a small museum.

opening_hours.notes: Confirm access times outside of mass schedules; museum hours may differ

places.place_tip: Located a block from Plaza 9 de Julio. Admire the colorful exterior and tall bell tower. Interior is also ornate.
places.cost: Free (church entry); Museum may have fee
places.address: Caseros esquina Córdoba, A4400 Salta, Argentina

attribution.title: Third Baptist Church of San Francisco
attribution.author: Michael Mangus
attribution.description: A photograph of Third Baptist Church taken from the intersection of Pierce Street and McAllister Street, San Francisco. On the right side of the photo there is a two-story stucco building with narrow rectangular windows and a single cross-shaped window over the front door. The roof appears flat at the facade, but a gable is visible offset from the roofline running the length of the nave. A circular colonnade joins the main building to a tower, roughly twice as tall, topped by a large cross painted gold. The tower has a three-by-four grid of windows on each face in the style of a lantern tower. Both structures are light tan in color, with darker rectangular accents aligned with the windows. A short flight of stairs connects the colonnade to the sidewalk, which is dotted with trees. Constructed in 1952, the Third Baptist Church complex is a San Francisco Designated Landmark.

places.name: Train to the Clouds (Tren a las Nubes)
places.ai_summary: Famous high-altitude tourist train journey starting from Salta city (or San Antonio de los Cobres on shorter trips). Travels through dramatic Andean landscapes, crossing viaducts like the iconic Polvorilla Viaduct at over 4,200 meters. A long day trip focused on scenery.

opening_hours.notes: Requires advance booking; schedule varies seasonally, check website

places.suggested_duration: Full-day (from Salta) or Half-day (from San Antonio)
places.place_tip: Book well in advance. Be prepared for high altitude (coca leaves/tea often offered). The full trip from Salta combines bus and train segments. Bring warm clothes.
places.address: Departure from Salta Train Station / San Antonio de los Cobres

attribution.title: Tren nubes trenesarg
attribution.author: Ministry of Transport of Argentina
attribution.description: Argentine Tren a las Nubes during its first trip after service had been suspended. Locomotive and coaches are painted in State-owned "Trenes Argentinos" corporate colors.

places.name: Salinas Grandes (Salt Flats, day trip)
places.ai_summary: Vast salt flats located in the Puna region, on the border of Salta and Jujuy provinces. Features stunning white landscapes, hexagonal salt patterns, and reflective pools (during rainy season). Accessible via RN52.

opening_hours.notes: High altitude desert; best visited during daylight

places.suggested_duration: 1-2 hours (on site); Full-day trip from Salta/Purmamarca
places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round (dry season Apr-Nov clearer, wet season Dec-Mar has reflective pools)
places.place_tip: Requires a long day trip, often combined with Purmamarca/Quebrada de Humahuaca. High altitude (over 3,400m), bring sunglasses, sunscreen, hat, water. Engage local guides at the site for access to pools/deeper areas.
places.address: Salinas Grandes, Ruta Nacional 52, Salta/Jujuy Province, Argentina

attribution.title: Salinas Grandes Córdoba
attribution.author: Arianza1
attribution.description: Ruta Nacional 60 en la provincia de Córdoba, a su paso por las Salinas Grandes

places.name: Quebrada de Humahuaca (UNESCO, day trip)
places.ai_summary: Dramatic, colorful mountain valley in Jujuy province (north of Salta), a UNESCO World Heritage site known for its pre-Inca and colonial history, indigenous culture, and stunning geological formations like the Hill of Seven Colors (Purmamarca) and Painter's Palette (Maimará).

opening_hours.notes: Valley accessible via RN9; towns/attractions have own hours

places.place_tip: Often visited as a day trip from Salta or base yourself in Purmamarca or Tilcara. Key towns include Purmamarca, Maimará, Tilcara (with Pucará ruins), and Humahuaca. High altitude.
places.cost: Free (drive/town visits); fees for specific sites (e.g., Pucará)
places.address: Quebrada de Humahuaca, Ruta Nacional 9, Jujuy Province, Argentina

places.name: Calchaquí Valleys Route
places.ai_summary: Scenic region south of Salta city, encompassing routes RN68 (towards Cafayate) and RN40/RP33 (via Cachi). Known for dramatic red rock formations (Quebrada de las Conchas on RN68), high-altitude vineyards (Cafayate), colonial towns (Cachi, Molinos), and pre-Inca ruins.

opening_hours.notes: Public roads; parts unpaved (esp. RN40/RP33), check conditions

places.place_tip: Requires driving (car rental, ideally high clearance for RN40/RP33) or multi-day tour. Allow ample time. Key stops: Quebrada de las Conchas, Cafayate, Cachi, Los Cardones NP.
places.address: Valles Calchaquíes (RN68, RN40, RP33), Salta Province, Argentina

attribution.title: Quebrada de Cafayate
attribution.author: Own work
attribution.description: Vista de la Quebrada de Cafayate, en el punto denominado Tres Cruces.

places.name: Cachi Village
places.ai_summary: Charming colonial village in the Calchaquí Valleys, known for its whitewashed adobe buildings, cobblestone streets, historic church (Iglesia San José), and archaeological museum. Set against the backdrop of Nevado de Cachi mountain.

opening_hours.notes: Check museum hours

places.place_tip: Located along RN40 (partially unpaved access via RP33/Cuesta del Obispo). Relaxing atmosphere. Visit the church and archaeological museum.
places.address: Cachi, Salta Province, Argentina

attribution.title: Quebrada de Cafayate
attribution.author: Own work
attribution.description: Vista de la Quebrada de Cafayate, en el punto denominado Tres Cruces.

places.name: Cafayate Wine Region
places.ai_summary: High-altitude wine region in the Calchaquí Valleys, renowned for its Torrontés white wine, as well as Malbec and Cabernet Sauvignon. Features numerous wineries around the town of Cafayate offering tours and tastings amidst stunning mountain scenery.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking highly recommended for winery visits/tastings

places.suggested_duration: Half-day to Multi-day (depending on number of visits)
places.best_time_to_visit: Apr–Nov (pleasant weather, avoid peak summer heat)
places.place_tip: Book winery visits in advance. Many wineries are walkable or cyclable from Cafayate town. Try the local Torrontés wine. Combine with Quebrada de las Conchas drive.
places.address: Cafayate and surroundings, Salta Province, Argentina

attribution.title: Catedral de Nuestra Señora del Rosario, Cafayate 01
attribution.author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution.description: Our Lady of Rosary Cathedral, Cafayate, Argentina

places.name: Los Cardones National Park
places.ai_summary: National Park located along the RP33 road between Salta and Cachi, characterized by its arid landscape dominated by thousands of large cardón grande cacti. Features scenic viewpoints like Piedra del Molino pass and the Recta Tin Tin (a long straight road).

opening_hours.notes: Mainly visited by driving through on RP33; check road conditions

places.place_tip: Stop at viewpoints along RP33, especially Piedra del Molino (highest point) and Recta Tin Tin. Be prepared for high altitude and dry conditions.
places.address: Parque Nacional Los Cardones, RP33, Salta Province, Argentina

places.name: Purmamarca Hill of Seven Colors
places.ai_summary: Famous multi-hued hill ('Cerro de los Siete Colores') that backdrops the charming village of Purmamarca in the Quebrada de Humahuaca (Jujuy Province). The colors are due to different mineral sediments and are best viewed in morning light.

opening_hours.notes: Natural landmark viewable from village/viewpoints

places.best_time_to_visit: Apr–Nov (dry season); Morning for best light on colors
places.place_tip: Located in Jujuy province, often visited on day trips from Salta that include Salinas Grandes. Walk the 'Paseo de los Colorados' trail behind the hill. Village has artisan market.
places.address: Cerro de los Siete Colores, Purmamarca, Jujuy Province, Argentina

attribution.title: Cerro de los 7 colores
attribution.author: Abuelodelanada
attribution.description: Cerro de los siete colores (Purmamarca, provincia de Jujuy, Argentina) vista desde la Ruta

places.name: Museum of Fine Arts Salta
places.ai_summary: Museo de Bellas Artes de Salta, located in a historic mansion near Plaza 9 de Julio. Focuses on art from Salta and the Northwest region, from colonial times to contemporary works.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can vary, confirm locally

places.place_tip: Good place to see regional art in a beautiful historic building.
places.address: Av. Belgrano 992, A4400 Salta, Argentina
places.name_native: Museo de Bellas Artes de Salta

places.name: Convento San Bernardo
places.ai_summary: One of Salta's oldest religious buildings, originally a hermitage, later a convent. Known primarily for its intricately carved wooden door (made by indigenous artisans) dating from 1762. Still an active convent (Carmelite nuns).

opening_hours.Monday: Exterior viewable; interior access very limited
opening_hours.notes: Interior usually not open to public visits due to cloistered nuns

places.place_tip: Focus on admiring the historic carved door from the outside. Located a few blocks from Plaza 9 de Julio.
places.address: Caseros 73, A4400 Salta, Argentina

attribution.description: Façade of the monastery of San Norberto (Madrid).

places.name: Balcarce Street (Nightlife)
places.ai_summary: Street in Salta known for its concentration of 'peñas folklóricas' (restaurants/bars featuring live traditional folk music and dancing), as well as other bars and nightclubs. Comes alive in the evenings, especially on weekends.

opening_hours.notes: Peñas usually start later in the evening (e.g., after 9 PM)

places.place_tip: Good place to experience live Argentine folk music and regional food. Reservations recommended for popular peñas. Located near the train station.
places.address: Calle Balcarce (between Alsina & Ameghino approx), Salta, Argentina

places.name: Cuesta del Obispo Scenic Drive
places.ai_summary: Spectacular winding mountain road (part of RP33) connecting the Lerma Valley to the higher Calchaquí Valley (en route to Cachi). Features numerous hairpin turns, dramatic cliffs, condor sightings, and culminates at Piedra del Molino pass (3,457m) bordering Los Cardones NP.

opening_hours.notes: Public road (RP33); mostly unpaved, requires careful driving, check conditions

places.suggested_duration: Variable (part of drive to Cachi, allow 2-3 hours for ascent/stops)
places.place_tip: Drive slowly and carefully, especially on unpaved sections and hairpin turns ('caracoles'). Stop at viewpoints. High altitude.
places.address: Ruta Provincial 33 (Cuesta del Obispo), Salta Province, Argentina

places.name: Molinos Town
places.ai_summary: Small, historic town in the Calchaquí Valleys along RN40. Features adobe architecture, a well-preserved colonial church (Iglesia San Pedro Nolasco de los Molinos), and the Hacienda de Molinos hotel (a converted historic estate).

opening_hours.notes: Quiet village; check hours for church/hotel visits

places.place_tip: Good stop or overnight base while exploring the central Calchaquí Valleys (RN40). Visit the historic church.
places.address: Molinos, Salta Province, Argentina

places.name: Parque San Martín
places.ai_summary: Large urban park in Salta city, near the bus terminal and base of Cerro San Bernardo. Features a lake with paddle boats, green spaces, playgrounds, and the Teleférico (cable car) station.

opening_hours.notes: Public park; Teleférico has own hours

places.place_tip: Pleasant place for a walk or to relax. Location of the cable car base station to Cerro San Bernardo.
places.address: Parque San Martín, Salta, Argentina

attribution.author: MacAllenBrothers
attribution.description: Gates of General San Martín Park.

places.name: Craft Market Mercado Artesanal
places.ai_summary: Large market housed in a historic building outside Salta's city center, showcasing a wide variety of handicrafts from across the province, including textiles (ponchos, blankets), pottery, leather goods, silverwork, and wood carvings.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can vary, confirm locally

places.place_tip: Located a short taxi/bus ride from the center. Good selection of regional crafts, potentially better prices/quality than central tourist shops.
places.address: Av. San Martín 2555, A4400 Salta, Argentina
